 Ms. Levine has a history of obstructive sleep apnea, currently controlled despite ongoing adherence challenges with CPAP therapy. She has not been prescribed any medications for this condition. Continuous monitoring and adherence support are recommen

ded.

 Ms. Levine uses chew tobacco daily, a habit she started on February 25, 2023. She has not expressed any desire to quit. Counseling on the risks associated with tobacco use was provided.

 Ms. Levine reports consuming approximately four alcoholic drinks per week. No further action is indicated at this time, but she was advised to be mindful of the potential impacts on her sleep and overall health.
